jobs.title: Linux System Administrator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Linux System Administrator is responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, security, and performance of the organization’s Linux-based servers and infrastructure, both on premises and in the cloud.

The role ensures high availability and reliability of critical systems, automates routine operations, and works closely with development, network, and security teams to support business applications and services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Administration & Operations**

* Install, configure, patch, and maintain Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky/AlmaLinux,

Ubuntu, Debian) across physical, virtual, and cloud environments.

* Manage user accounts, groups, permissions, sudo access, and directory integration (LDAP,

FreeIPA, or Active Directory).

* Administer core services such as SSH, DNS, DHCP, NTP, NFS/Samba, web servers (Apache,

Nginx), and mail relays.

* Manage storage, file systems, LVM, and RAID; plan capacity and handle disk expansion.

* Perform routine health checks, troubleshoot system issues, and conduct root-cause analysis for incidents.

**Virtualization (VMware)**

* Design, deploy and maintain VMware vSphere environments (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN or

shared datastores, vMotion, DRS, HA).

* Build and manage virtual machines, templates and resource pools; right-size workloads and plan cluster capacity.

* Patch and upgrade hypervisors and vCenter, and plan lifecycle and hardware refreshes.

* Troubleshoot performance, storage and network issues in the virtual environment.

NAS and Storage

* Administer NAS and shared storage platforms: volumes, shares (NFS/SMB), snapshots,

replication, quotas and access permissions.

* Plan capacity, monitor storage health and performance, and manage disk expansion and

RAID.

* Maintain storage integration with VMware datastores and backup systems. Firewall and Network Security (Fortinet)

* Configure, manage and troubleshoot FortiGate firewalls: policies, NAT, VPN (IPsec and

SSL), SD-WAN, UTM profiles and logging.

* Manage high-availability firewall clusters and firmware upgrades, with tested rollback plans.

* Use FortiAnalyzer or equivalent for log review, reporting and incident investigation.

* Run periodic firewall rule reviews to remove unused or overly permissive rules.

**Networking, VLAN and Routing**

* Design and support LAN/WAN networks: switching, VLAN segmentation, inter-VLAN routing, trunking, STP and link aggregation.

* Configure and troubleshoot routers and routing protocols (static routes, OSPF, BGP) and

core network services (DHCP, DNS, NTP).

* Apply working knowledge of TCP/IP, VPN, QoS, load balancing and packet analysis tools to

isolate faults quickly.

* Maintain network diagrams, IP addressing plans and configuration backups.

**Security & Compliance**

* Apply OS and application security patches in line with the patch management policy.

* Harden systems against CIS benchmarks; configure firewalls (iptables/nftables, firewalld) and SELinux/AppArmor.

* Manage SSH keys, certificates (TLS/SSL), and secrets securely.

* Support vulnerability remediation, audit requests, and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO

27001, SOC 2, Data Privacy Act).

* Review system and security logs and respond to suspicious activity.

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Automate provisioning, configuration, and repetitive tasks using Bash, Python, and Ansible (or similar tools).

* Maintain infrastructure definitions with Terraform or equivalent IaC tooling.

* Support CI/CD pipelines and containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes) in collaboration with DevOps teams.

**Monitoring, Backup & Recovery**

* Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Nagios) and centralized logging.

* Manage backup schedules, test restores, and maintain disaster recovery procedures.

* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to production incidents within agreed SLAs.

Platform Migration & Modernization

* Plan and execute migrations from end-of-life or legacy Linux platforms (e.g., CentOS 7/8) to supported distributions such as RHEL, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, or Ubuntu LTS.

* Assess existing servers and applications for compatibility, dependencies, and risks before

migration.

* Perform in-place upgrades (e.g., Leapp, ELevate, convert2rhel) or rebuild-and-cutover

migrations, as appropriate.

* Migrate workloads between on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments with minimal downtime.

* Develop migration runbooks, test plans, and rollback procedures; validate services after

cutover.

* Coordinate migration schedules and communications with application owners and

stakeholders.

**Documentation & Collaboration**

* Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, runbooks, and standard operating

procedures.

* Follow ITIL-aligned change, incident, and problem management processes.

* Provide Tier 2/3 technical support and mentor junior team members.

* Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to improve reliability and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or

equivalent practical experience.

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience administering Linux servers in a production environment.

* Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere, KVM, Proxmox, or Hyper-V).

* Experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Proven experience migrating servers and applications between Linux distributions or major OS versions.

**Technical Skills**

* Operating Systems: Strong command of RHEL-based (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky/AlmaLinux)

and Debian-based (Debian, Ubuntu) distributions.

* Scripting: Proficiency in Bash; working knowledge of Python.

* Configuration Management: Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or SaltStack.

* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VLANs, load balancers, VPNs, and network troubleshooting too

jobs.description:
**Role Description**

The IT Network/Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the planning, deployment, operation, and maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure across offices and distribution centers. This role covers network architecture, servers, storage, data center cabling, CCTV systems, and end-user support, ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of all IT systems. The role requires strong hands-on technical skills, cross-team coordination, and the ability to respond to critical incidents when needed.

**Qualifications**  
1. A bachelor's degree in information technology, computer/software engineering, or a related field.  
2. Over 5 years of experience in network and desktop maintenance.  
3. Those who hold certifications such as CCNA, HCIA, H3CNE or above are preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

1. Network: Familiar with the configuration and management of network devices such as switches and routers, understand basic cyber security knowledge, possess troubleshooting capabilities, and be aware of the ISO 7-layer and TCP/IP 4-layer architectures.  
2. System: Proficient in managing Windows Server and Linux (such as CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.) operating systems and mastering and configuring RAID arrays.  
3. Desktop: Proficient in troubleshooting common issues with PCs, printers, and software, skilled in installing Windows, understands the working principle of CCTV, and can guide suppliers to complete the deployment and construction of CCTV systems.  
4. Data Center: Understand the process and standards of comprehensive cabling in data centers, be familiar with commonly used equipment in data centers, be familiar with the weak current construction process, distinguish commonly used transmission media, and be able to independently make Category 5 and Category 6 RJ45 connectors.  
5. Strong sense of responsibility, with good communication skills and teamwork spirit.  
6. Able to handle unexpected breakdowns during non-working hours, capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously and working under pressure.

**Responsibilities and Duties**  
1. Select network equipment, plan the network architecture of the distribution center and office.  
2. Guide suppliers to complete the weak current engineering and data center construction of the distribution center.  
3. Assist in formulating and implementing IT operation and maintenance specifications to ensure the security and stability of the company's information systems.  
4. Guide regional IT to rack and unrack network devices and servers and organize and standardize cabinet wiring.  
5. Configure the CCTV system and guide the supplier on construction standards  
6. Resolve desktop malfunctions, address all issues colleagues encounter with their IT systems and software, and provide colleagues with training on cyber security and computer usage.  
7. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve hardware, software, and other network and system issues.  
8. Maintain, configure, and monitor network bandwidth usage and network performance to determine if adjustments are needed

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

J&T Express Philippines is a fast-growing logistics and express delivery company known for its nationwide reach, reliable service, and technology-driven operations. Since entering the Philippine market in 2019, the company has built a strong network of branches and hubs, offering efficient parcel delivery, e-commerce logistics, real-time tracking, and door-to-door pickup services. Committed to speed, convenience, and customer satisfaction, J&T Express helps businesses and individuals connect and deliver across the country with confidence.
